flags.why: This older sense describes being unable to bear or undertake something, rather than something being unbearable ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-b%E1%BA%A5t%20kham)).
flags.fix: unable to bear; unable to cope with or undertake

flags.why: The example incorrectly applies bất kham to the pain rather than to the person's inability to endure it.
flags.fix: Việc ấy khó khăn quá, sức tôi chắc bất kham. = That task is so difficult that I probably cannot manage it.

flags.why: Đoan means to assure or pledge, rather than the adverb certainly ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-%C4%91oan)).
The example defines the hymen instead of showing the word in use.
flags.fix: Cô ấy hỏi bác sĩ về màng trinh. = She asked the doctor about the hymen.
